evaluation: grouped 5-fold CV over ring_id, out-of-fold pooled, per-account cutoffs; T=5/10/30m is the primary regime and the full window is a reference row only
edge_admission: an edge is admitted only when its timestamp is at or before the cutoff of BOTH endpoints, because message passing is symmetric; self-loops added so isolated accounts still aggregate something
transductive_caveat: the GNN sees held-out nodes' features and structure during training (never their labels); XGBoost in evaluate.py sees nothing of the test rows. This is a real asymmetry in the GNN's favour and is not corrected, only declared
